newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound falls despite dollar offers. [CORRECTED 12:33 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound falls despite dollar offers. [CORRECTED 12:33 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects to show that the pound fell rather than rose against the dollar.)
The Egyptian pound fell against the dollar on Tuesday in a market where there were few takers in the market offering the U.S. currency, bankers said.
"Everyone is trying to sell at a higher rate which they are not getting, and that's why the pound is falling," one banker said.
Four actively trading banks quoted the dollar at between 3.3930 and 3.3950 pounds bid and 3.3940 and 3.3965 pounds offered in the interbank market.
The average exchange rate was 3.394125 bid and 3.39575 offered compared to 3.3935 bid and 3.395375 offered on Monday.
The Central Bank calculated the average rate at midday as 3.389847 pounds buy and 3.395669 pounds sell.
